p: ears: This psalm seems to have been made by some excellent prophet for the use of the people when the Church was in extreme misery, either at their return from Babylon or under Antiochus or in similar afflictions.
heathen with thy hand: That is, the Canaanites.
favour unto them: God's free mercy and love is the only fountain and beginning of the Church, De 4:37.
Jacob: Because you are our king, therefore deliver your people from their misery.
Through thee will we push down: Because they and their forefathers made both one Church, they apply that to themselves which before they attributed to their fathers.
shame: As they confessed before that their strength came from God, so now they acknowledge that this affliction came by his just judgment.
like sheep appointed for meat: Knowing God to be author of this calamity, they murmur not, but seek remedy at his hands who wounded them.
for nought: As slaves who are sold for a low price, you do not look for him who offers the most, but take the first offer.
confusion is continually before me: I dare not lift up my head for shame.
avenger: Meaning, the proud and cruel tyrant.

forgotten thee: They boast not of their virtues, but declare that they rest on God in the midst of their affliction: who did not punished their sins now, but by hard afflictions called them to the consideration of the heavenly joys.
strange god: They show that they honoured God correctly, because they trusted in him alone.
search this out: They take God to witness that they were upright toward him.
are we killed all the day: The faithful take comfort in this, that the wicked punish them not for their sins, but for because of God, Mt 5:10, 1Pe 4:14.
bowed down to the dust: There is no hope of recovery, unless you raise us up with your hand.
mercies' sake: Which is the only sufficient ransom to deliver both body and souls from all kinds of slavery and misery.
